category_definitions.definitions: Except dedicated assumed specifications counted under Axioms: actual def, abbrev, opaque, structure, class, inductive, instance and other definition-form declarations, including entire bodies and proof fields. Top-level notation definitions included; nested term/where bindings stay with their enclosing declaration.
category_definitions.axioms: Unproved mathematical assumptions in the retained partition, whether expressed as axiom/constant declarations, explicit theorem hypotheses, or dedicated specification definitions/structures. Referenced reusable data types and proved wrappers are not reclassified. Attached code scaffolding follows its declaration; comment-only lines are excluded. Not a transitive kernel-axiom inventory.
category_definitions.numbered_results: Explicitly mapped main/numbered result endpoint declarations, including complete proofs; public includes selected concrete alternative endpoints. Supporting proof declarations are helpers.
category_definitions.helpers: All remaining retained proof declarations plus declaration-free source scaffolding.

allocation: Docs/attributes attach to following declaration; other intervening scope/import/comment/blank lines attach to preceding declaration. Leading/trailing scaffold attaches first/last.
